summary: Iter-56 rigorous QA pass over exam attempts/reset, distractor stats UI, admin-only CSV, and miss-rate alert dedup + re-arm. 9/9 pytest cases pass. Every phase verified with exact HTTP evidence: (1a) learner blocked from CSV (403) and JSON insights (403), no CSV data in body. (1b) Admin CSV = 200 text/csv; charset=utf-8, attachment header, exact header row + 5 data rows, all 5 rows cross-validated against JSON insights (answered/correct/missed/miss_rate/top_wrong label+count/correct_answer all match, 0 mismatches). UI Export CSV downloads 'question-insights-exam-4.csv'. (3a) Learner submit at 3/3 → 400 'Maximum attempts reached'; POST /api/exams/4/attempts/reset (admin) → 200 {"deleted":3,"user_id":2}; learner regains submit rights. (2) After Q13 re-armed (PATCH explanation) and reset, learner performs fail/fail/pass — Q13 fires NEW QUESTION_MISS_ALERT notification + new question_miss_alert outbox rows; Q14/Q15 miss_alerted_at timestamps UNCHANGED (dedup ✓); learner ends Passed 100% (course-221 gate satisfied). (2 re-arm) PATCH Q13 explanation clears miss_alerted_at, subsequent fail/fail/pass re-fires (SECOND alert + new outbox rows) proving re-arm. (3b) Data integrity: distribution counts sum to 'answered' for all 5 questions, top_wrong count matches max wrong count in distribution. UI: Q13 tie case (2 wrong options each with 1 pick) — TOP DISTRACTOR badge rendered on 'Oxidative (aerobic)' (index 0, ie sorted by count desc then iteration order); exactly ONE badge per question; ✓ green on correct option (ATP-PC (phosphagen)). 3 'author alerted' chips visible on Q13/Q14/Q15. No console errors.

minor.issue: SECURITY FINDING (pre-existing, flagged per request): question objects returned to learner include the 'correct_answer' field — a learner making GET /api/exams/4 can see e.g. correct_answer='2' for every MCQ. This leaks answer keys. Recommend stripping correct_answer + explanation for LEARNER role in exam-detail serializer.

action_items: SECURITY: Strip 'correct_answer' (and consider 'explanation') from GET /api/exams/{id} response when caller role == LEARNER. Currently a learner GET on /api/exams/4 exposes correct_answer='2' etc for every MCQ, defeating the whole exam concept.
MINOR (non-blocking, per iter55 review comment): /api/admin/outbox uses key 'messages' whereas other list endpoints use 'items'/'results' — inconsistent.
critical_code_review_comments: SECURITY (highest): correct_answer leak on GET /api/exams/{id} for LEARNER role. Add role-based response filtering.
The insights response omits per-option percent — client computes it inline. Fine, but if CSV/exports ever want percent per option, centralise it in the service layer.
POST /api/exams/{id}/attempts/reset resets ALL attempts for the caller-supplied user; make sure audit-log captures actor + target user (verify in a follow-up test).
Distribution TIE tie-break is 'first by iteration/option index' — this is deterministic but undocumented. Consider adding a note in the API schema so consumers know.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter-56 fully verified with 9/9 pytest passing. If re-running: (a) POST /api/exams/4/attempts/reset requires no body except auth; returns {deleted:N,user_id:N}. (b) Answer keys index-based: Q13=2 (ATP-PC), Q14=1, Q15=1, Q16=2 (Volume), Q17=true. (c) To force a fresh Q13 alert you MUST first PATCH Q13 (any field including 'explanation') to clear miss_alerted_at, else dedup suppresses. (d) The Foundations exam attempts button is data-testid='exam-attempts-btn-4' (NOT the first row on /exams — first row is exam id 6 'Gym Health & Safety'). (e) Learner still has correct_answer visible on GET /api/exams/{id} — do NOT auto-fix in tests, this is an app-level design bug.
rca of the issue: The only real defect found is the pre-existing correct_answer leak in GET /api/exams/{id} for LEARNER role. Repro: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <learner_jwt>' https://learning-hub-968.preview.emergentagent.com/api/exams/4 | jq '.questions[0].correct_answer'` → returns '2'. Mitigation: in /app/backend/routers/exams.py (or the exam serializer), branch on current role and drop 'correct_answer' + 'explanation' fields when role == LEARNER, or use a separate LearnerExamOut schema.
